sources.rationale: Fresh publish authorization after extraction, before acceptance; keep all external calls outside SQL guards.
Guarded immutable revision acceptance, command replay/conflict and rollback. Replace material-only locking with the approved tenant/KB/source/generation/job order and pointer CAS.
Adapt metadata replay, changed-hash conflict, tenant/current-rights and transactional rollback negative scenarios to actual PostgreSQL activation.
Retain staged inventory across worker death; receipt is durable metadata, never an external exactly-once claim. Reject a file-journal as a second owner.
Retain explicit unknown/unavailable inventory semantics. Reject truncated display inventories as publication authority.
Keep previous usable generations for explicit history; resolve active exactly once. Reject short signatures, directory-readiness heuristics and latest/legacy fallback.
Adapt interrupted staging, incomplete generation and changed-source regression scenarios. Use PostgreSQL barriers, persisted FTS checks and current epochs rather than donor backend assumptions.

reuseScope: Algorithmic adaptation and regression scenarios only. No donor runtime dependency, framework coupling, source text copying, file-journal owner or upstream test pass claimed.

licenses.agentools: Private reuse authority from the execution-input; no donor implementation copied.
licenses.deeptutor: Apache-2.0; retained license/notices in docs/architecture/third-party/DeepTutor-LICENSE.txt and DeepTutor-THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

newCodeRationale: The existing KnowKit sealed-generation checks, canonical probes, policy receipts, dependency graph, transactional outbox and CAS remain the owners. New small PHP application/port/adapter glue atomically assembles an exact immutable snapshot and records its original receipt; donor implementations lack the approved tenant/epoch/fence contracts.
sourceGaps: No plan read API is exposed; required normative reads were supplied inline. Optional full reuse-policy context was not loaded.
Plan receipt mirror was not written: result_contract.plan_mutation is forbidden. Tracked tests/publication/activate/evidence/P3.4-reuse.json is the executor handoff.
External owner freshness is bounded by its host contract; real PostgreSQL tests prove local serialization only.

validation.donorHashes: All seven shortlisted SHA256 values matched the execution-input; relevant algorithm and regression sections were inspected.
